task.title: P6-051: Correct the stale needs pick list composition line in app-ui.md
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 10 — Hygiene and docs). Original id: P6-051. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md, specs/collection-api.md.

**Correct the stale composition line at `specs/app-ui.md:123-124`** — the needs pick list is composed from `needs` + `holdings_of_oracle` + `move_batch`, **not** `move_cards` + `suggested_destinations`. `suggested_destinations` ranks destinations for a card, but on the needs page the destination is the page itself, so the read needed is source-side. The wording predates `NeedRow.locations` existing; the correction already lives in Findings (`app-ui.md:1234-1245`) and in `lib.rs:1306-1310` but was never back-ported to the summary line.
